title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Position : Human Resource Executive Experience : 12 Years Reporting To : Founder / CEO or Designated Manager Employment Type : Full-time Salary: Up to 20K /Month 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for an HR Executive who can take care of the regular HR work in the office and keep things properly organized. The person will mainly handle recruitment, employee joining, attendance, leave, documentation, employee coordination and other day-to-day HR activities. This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable talking to people, follows up on work regularly and does not wait for someone to remind them about every task. 
 What You Will Be Doing : 
 You will be responsible for handling recruitment activities, starting from finding candidates and checking CVs to arranging interviews, speaking with candidates, following up with them and coordinating their joining. You will keep track of open positions and make sure candidates are followed up properly. If there is a delay in hiring, you should be able to identify it and bring it to the manager's attention. You will also take care of the joining process for new employees, including collecting documents, KYC, induction, access, KRAs and initial training coordination. Attendance and leave records need to be maintained properly. Employee documents and other HR records should also be kept updated and confidential. You will coordinate with managers regarding employee KRAs and performance reviews and make sure the required information and follow-ups are completed on time. Employees may come to you with regular questions or concerns. You should be able to understand the issue, handle it where possible and involve management when the matter needs a decision. You will also help organize employee activities such as training, birthdays, small team events and other engagement activities. When an employee leaves the company, you will coordinate the exit process, including notice period follow-up, handover, company asset return, exit interview and documentation. A weekly HR update will also need to be prepared covering recruitment status, attendance, new joining's, employee issues, pending documentation and other important HR matters. If you notice repeated issues with attendance, employee behavior or any other HR matter, you should bring them to the management's attention instead of ignoring them. 
 What We Are Looking For : 
 Good communication skills (English) and the confidence to speak with employees and candidates. Someone who is comfortable making regular follow-up calls and messages. Good knowledge of basic HR and recruitment activities. Ability to conduct initial candidate discussions and understand whether a candidate is suitable for the position. Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HRMS or other HR software will be an advantage. Good documentation and record-keeping habits. Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality. Someone who can remain calm while dealing with employee issues or difficult conversations. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work and gets things done without needing constant supervision. 
 The Right Person For This Role : 
 The right person will be friendly and approachable with employees but will also know when to be firm. You should be comfortable working independently, following up with people and keeping track of several things at the same time. We do not expect you to make management-level decisions. We do expect you to identify problems, keep the management informed and make sure routine HR work does not get stuck. 
 Please Note : 
 Final decisions related to hiring, salary, increments, promotions, termination and major disciplinary matters will be taken by the Founder, CEO or the authorized manager.

title: Hr Operations Associate
description:
About the Role Jindal Projects & Engineers is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Executive / Officer to manage day-to-day HR activities and ensure smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes. The role will involve employee documentation, attendance and leave management, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, recruitment support, employee engagement, and HR MIS. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a project/engineering/construction environment and should have strong coordination, communication, and documentation skills. Key Responsibilities 1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Manage employee joining, onboarding, induction, transfers, confirmations, and exits. Maintain accurate and updated employee personnel files and HR records. Prepare appointment letters, offer letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documentation. Ensure timely completion of employee documentation and joining formalities. Maintain employee master data in HRMS/ERP and ensure data accuracy. 2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination Monitor employee attendance, leave, late coming, overtime, and shift records. Coordinate with departments/projects for monthly attendance inputs. Prepare and verify payroll inputs including attendance, overtime, incentives, deductions, new joiners, and exits. Coordinate with the payroll/accounts team for timely and accurate salary processing. Address employee queries related to attendance, leave, salary, and benefits. 
 3. Statutory Compliance Support compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Coordinate documentation related to PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, Labour Welfare Fund , and other applicable compliances. Maintain statutory registers, records, and employee documentation. Coordinate with consultants/agencies for statutory filings and compliance requirements. Support internal and external HR/statutory audits. 4. HR Policies & Process Management Implement company HR policies and procedures. Ensure employees understand and follow HR policies, attendance rules, code of conduct, and workplace procedures. Assist in developing and maintaining HR SOPs and processes. Identify operational HR issues and coordinate with management for resolution. 5. Employee Relations & Engagement Handle routine employee queries and grievances professionally. Coordinate employee engagement activities, meetings, and communication. Maintain good employee relations across office, project, and site teams. Assist management in resolving employee-related issues. 6. HR MIS & Reporting Prepare regular HR MIS reports related to: Headcount Attendance Attrition Recruitment Leave Overtime Payroll inputs Manpower deployment Maintain HR trackers and databases. Provide timely HR reports and information to management. 
 Required Qualifications Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline . MBA/PG Diploma in HR will be an added advantage. 25 years of experience in HR Operations; experience in engineering, construction, infrastructure, manufacturing, or project-based organizations preferred. Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and Word . Experience with HRMS/ERP systems will be an advantage. Required Skills Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management. Good understanding of attendance, leave, payroll, and HR documentation. Basic knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good coordination and follow-up skills. Strong attention to detail and documentation. Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee information. Good problem-solving and organizational skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with multiple departments/sites. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and timeliness of HR records and MIS. Timely completion of joining and exit formalities. Payroll and attendance input accuracy. Timely statutory compliance documentation. Recruitment and manpower coordination efficiency. Employee query/grievance resolution time. HR documentation and audit readiness. Employee data accuracy and HRMS updation. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with experience in project-based organizations, engineering companies, EPC, construction, infrastructure, manufacturing, or site-based operations will be preferred.

Key Skills: HR Ops,Employee Data Management,HRO,Management,Data,Hrsd,Ops,Operations
